description: The tool gets a dialysis facility by its six-character CCN. It returns Medicare's star rating, the chain, stations and services, and every published figure in the dialysis facility file under CMS's column name. This includes death, hospital admission, readmission and transfusion rates with their confidence limits and CMS's category. A blank figure is null and never zero.

ccn.description: The facility's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN).

name: get_dialysis_facility
title: Get a dialysis facility
